title: Application of integration
competency: Use integrals to find totals from rates.

keywords.def: A known value, like s(0) = 9, used to find the constant C.

en.text: Integrating a rate gives the total change: marginal profit gives profit, velocity gives displacement, a sales rate gives total sales. For a formula with + C, use a known starting value (like s(0)) to find C.

am.text: የለውጥ መጠንን ስናዋህድ ጠቅላላ ለውጡን እናገኛለን፤ ከህዳግ ትርፍ ትርፍ፣ ከፍጥነት ርቀት። C ን በመነሻ እሴት እናገኛለን።

screens.title: From speed to distance
screens.ask: A braking car has speed v(t) = −1.197t² + 58.67 ft/s for 0 ≤ t ≤ 7. The stopping distance is
screens.after:
Velocity is the rate of change of distance.
The area under a rate graph is the total change.
So distance = ∫ from 0 to 7 v(t) dt ≈ 273.83 ft.
v(7) ≈ 0 is the speed at the end; v(0) × 7 pretends the car never slows.

screens.title: The braking car
screens.ask: v(t) = −1.197t² + 58.67 ft/s. Move the time t.
outs: Distance so far s(t) = ∫ from 0 to t v
screens.note: The speed falls to about 0 at t = 7. The distance keeps growing, more slowly, to about 273.83 ft.

screens.title: Integrating a rate
paras: If F′(x) is a rate, ∫ from a to b of F′(x) dx = F(b) − F(a) is the total change.
For an indefinite integral, an initial value fixes C.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A known value, like s(0) = 9, used to find the constant C.

screens.text: Position from velocity with an initial condition: v(t) = 5t⁴ and s(0) = 9. s(t) =
screens.why:
s(t) = ∫ v(t) dt = ∫ 5t⁴ dt = 5 × t⁵/5 + C = t⁵ + C.
Use s(0) = 9: 0 + C = 9, so C = 9.
s(t) = t⁵ + 9.
Trap: 20t³ is the derivative of v, not the integral.

screens.ask: Total profit from marginal profit: an airline has P′(x) = √x − 6 (hundreds of $). P(60) ≈ ___ hundred $
Total profit from marginal profit: P′(x) = x^(1/5) dollars per foot drilled. The profit for a 250 ft well ≈ $ ___
Total from a flow rate: a tank fills at r(t) = 3t² litres per minute. The water added from t = 0 to t = 4 is ___ L
screens.why:
Total = ∫ from 0 to 4 3t² dt.
Anti-derivative: t³.
4³ − 0³ = 64 L.

screens.text: Integrate a rate to get a total: match each rate with the total it gives.
screens.why:
Integrating a rate over an interval gives the total change.
Units: (input unit) × (rate unit). s × m/s = m; items × birr/item = birr.
min × L/min = L; days × $/day = $.
screens.clue: Multiply the units: what is left?

screens.ask: Position from velocity: v(t) = 6t + 2 m/s and s(0) = 5 m. Find s(3) = ___ m
screens.why:
s(t) = ∫ (6t + 2) dt = 3t² + 2t + C.
s(0) = 5 gives C = 5.
s(3) = 27 + 6 + 5 = 38 m.
Trap: 33 forgets the starting position 5.

items.ask: Total profit from marginal profit: P′(x) = x^(1/5). P(250) ≈ $ ___

items.text: Total sales from a rate: S′(t) = 20eᵗ $ per day. Sales in the first 5 days:
items.why:
Total = ∫ from 0 to 5 20eᵗ dt.
The anti-derivative of eᵗ is eᵗ.
20e⁵ − 20e⁰ = 20(e⁵ − 1).
≈ 20(147.41) ≈ $2948.
Trap: 20e⁵ forgets e⁰ = 1 at the lower limit.

test.ask: Distance from velocity: v(t) = 4t m/s. The distance from t = 0 to t = 5 is ___ m
test.why:
Distance = ∫ from 0 to 5 4t dt.
Anti-derivative: 2t².
2(25) − 0 = 50 m.

test.text: Position from velocity with an initial condition: s′(t) = 3t² and s(0) = 2. s(t) =
test.why:
s(t) = ∫ 3t² dt = t³ + C.
s(0) = 2 gives C = 2.
s(t) = t³ + 2.

test.ask: Total extra cost from marginal cost: C′(x) = 10 + 2x. The extra cost from x = 0 to x = 10 is ___
test.why:
Extra cost = ∫ from 0 to 10 (10 + 2x) dx.
Anti-derivative: 10x + x².
(100 + 100) − 0 = 200.

notes.text: Example 2 prints "s(t) = t⁵ = 9"; it should be s(t) = t⁵ + 9.
Exercise 2.29 Q1 writes P′(t) with x; read as P′(x) = x^(1/5). Q2 needs ∫ eᵗ dt, not taught in the unit.

screens.text: Evaluate the definite integral: ∫ from 1 to 2 3x² dx = ?
screens.why:
Anti-derivative: F(x) = x³.
F(2) = 8. F(1) = 1.
8 − 1 = 7.
Trap: 8 forgets to subtract F(1).
